description: Edit the to, subject, or text of a draft that has not been sent yet — omitted fields keep their current value. Call this when a draft needs changes, e.g. a human declined to approve it and you are revising it. The reply target cannot be changed (create a new draft to reply to a different message), and a draft that is already sending or sent can no longer be edited.

id.description: Id of the draft to edit, from create_draft or list_drafts.

subject.description: Optional. New subject line. Omit to keep the current one.

text.description: Optional. New plain-text body. Omit to keep the current one.

to.description: Optional. New recipient address. Omit to keep the current one.

name: update_draft
